_comment: WJD stem mirror, validation split (experiments/03-wjd-jazz-stems/03-dataset-and-wiring.md). Items are WHOLE TRACKS, one per target stem; the prompt is the stem's instrument name(s) from meta/<Track>.json and the condition is the drum stem's causal RMS envelope at the latent rate (1 channel, stable_audio_3/data/features.py), written into the controls sidecar by --features. Since 2026-10-02 the sidecar also carries the two 2-ch causal TRIA controls of experiment 3.4 (drums_tria_fixed, drums_tria_ema; dataset constants in configs/dataset_configs/features/wjd_drums_tria_stats.json), which custom_md_wjd.py returns when WJD_CONTROL_MODE=rms,tria_fixed,tria_ema, the sbatch default. Four dataset entries, so the output lands in <output_path>/{bass,other,piano,guitar}/ with independent id sequences; the pre-encoded config lists all four paths. Pass --sample_size on the CLI, never here (see the Slakh configs for why). Tracks are 131-901 s, median 310 s: encode whole tracks with --sample_size 16760832 --batch_size 1 and no --pad (380 s cap; the 12 longer tracks lose their tail) and crop at train time with latent_crop_length + random_crop. WJD_CONTROL_MODE=audio in the environment switches the module to returning the drum waveform under drums_audio instead (then use --controls drums_audio); 'both' gives both. No augmentation: --features and --augment_variants > 1 are mutually exclusive. The silence gates apply to the target only; the drums are gated by the module (RMS floor over the valid window).
